desc:
QUICK AND EASY: Just add water, milk and butter; boil, stir, let sit, and serve for a delicious side dish

PANTRY STAPLE: Keep these instant sweet potato mashed potatoes in your pantry as an easy side dish for any meal

SERVING SIZE: Package contains about four servings of sweet potatoes

REAL POTATOES: Made with real potatoes

CONTAINS: 4.5 oz (Pack of 8)
features:
Features

  1. Made with real russet and sweet potatoes.
  2. Easy-to-make instant mashed mix, Just add water, milk, and butter.
  3. 4.5 oz pouch (about 4 servings).
  4. Slightly sweet flavor with added brown sugar.
  5. 120 calories per serving.
  6. Low fat (0.5g) and moderate sodium (250mg).
  7. Provides 2g dietary fiber and 2g protein per serving.

Benefits

  1. No peeling or boiling required
  2. Consistent flavor and texture every time
  3. Great for both everyday meals and holiday dinners
  4. Kid-friendly, sweet, and savory taste
  5. Low in fat – fits into balanced diets
  6. Helps support digestive health with fiber
ingredients: Russet Potatoes*, Sugar, Sweet Potato*, Brown Sugar, Salt, Modified Corn Starch, Vegetable Oil (canola, soybean and/or sunflower oil). Contains 0.5 %or less of: Mono And Diglycerides, Cinnamon, Color (caramel color and annatto extract), Silicon Dioxide (anticaking agent), Natural and Artificial Flavor. Freshness Preserved By Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Sodium Bisulfite and Citric Acid. *Dried
